description:
Discover real estate listings across Türkiye directly through ChatGPT with a fast and intelligent search experience. Our app consolidates a comprehensive range of properties—from apartments and villas to land and commercial spaces—enabling you to efficiently identify the options that best match your requirements.

Type @Emlakjet and describe your needs in natural language: a three-bedroom apartment for sale in Kadıköy, or a sea-view villa in Çeşme or an investment plot under 2 million TL in Balıkesir. Our advanced search engine interprets your criteria and surfaces the most relevant listings, displaying essential details such as price, size, and location at a glance.

The map-based search feature allows you to explore listings visually, discover nearby opportunities through interactive pins, and gain a clearer understanding of each property's surroundings. Select any listing to view photos and detailed specifications. Once you find a property that meets your expectations, proceed to the full listing page to review all features and connect directly with the advertise
